display_information.name: Kudos Jaya
display_information.description: Brighten someone's day with a heartfelt thank you
display_information.long_description:
Add a spark to your team’s day with KudosBot. Recognize and celebrate your colleagues’ efforts instantly with a simple command. 

Boost morale, foster a culture of appreciation, and make every accomplishment shine.

Because every “thank you” counts. 🌟

To get started, go to the #wearejaya channel and type the command /give-kudos to start spreading gratitude and giving kudos to a colleague. 

If you were presented with a kudos, check your balance on the app's home page.
You can find the app by typing @Kudos Jaya.


If you already have a balance, just click the redeem button on the app's home page and redeem your gift card at one of the partner stores and enjoy!


If you have any suggestions, questions or find a bug. Contact <@leco> or <@rcabral>. :smile:
